summary: Fix unquote IndexError on empty string input.
issue_text: unquote('') in _utils.py raises IndexError because it accesses value[0] without checking string length first. This can occur when parsing digest auth WWW-Authenticate headers containing parameters with empty unquoted values (e.g. realm= instead of realm=""). The test must assert that calling unquote("") returns "" without crashing.
traceback_excerpt: httpx/_utils.py, in unquote: return value[1:-1] if value[0] == value[-1] == '"' else value; IndexError: string index out of range
